table4._method: 4A5 = Jun 2B ITC (available, forward charge, net of credit notes / B2BA differences) + reclaims of invoices found in Apr/May 2B that were reversed then; 4B1 = Sec 17(5) items claimed this month; 4B2 = Jun 2B ITC not taken (not in books, booked without GST, held for wrong head / other GSTIN, excess over books) plus credit notes booked but not yet in 2B; 4D1 = reclaims; 4D2 = 2B ITC not available. net_itc = 4A5 + 4A3 - 4B1 - 4B2.
